faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most important questions about our solutions
faq.a1: CreditDevice offers a complete solution for your entire credit management. We develop our products ourselves because we know the needs of our customers. Each product has its own strength – combined, our solutions become even more powerful.
faq.q2: Can the modules be used individually?
faq.a2: Yes. Our interactive modules — Credit Management Software, PolicyManager, Credit Information and Debt Collection — work independently of each other. However, as a complete solution, they develop their full strength.
faq.q3: How quickly can I reach a contact person?
faq.a3: We are an independent company. In practice, this means short communication channels and direct contact. The close relationship with our customers is also reflected in the development process of new products.
faq.q4: How do I get international credit information?
faq.a4: With our international online company reports, you receive worldwide credit information in the shortest possible time — without a contract, without a term or minimum order.
faq.q5: How does the PolicyManager help with trade credit insurance?
faq.a5: The PolicyManager brings together all important and relevant information from your trade credit insurance. Thanks to the notification system, you prevent compensation losses and keep credit limits always up to date.
faq.q6: What role does the Credit Management Software play?
faq.a6: Our Credit Management Software goes beyond pure accounts receivable management. It provides insights into the payment behaviour of your customers, so you can make decisions in advance, take targeted measures and minimise risks.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Learn more about our credit information
faq.a1: We source our data directly from the leading credit agencies in the respective countries – for maximum timeliness, reliability and international coverage.
faq.q2: How up-to-date is the credit information?
faq.a2: Our data is regularly updated. Depending on the country and source, you receive daily updated information or data updated within a few days.
faq.q3: Can I integrate the credit information?
faq.a3: Yes, we offer a REST API as well as webhooks for individual integrations.
faq.q4: What information is included in a credit report?
faq.a4: A typical report contains company master data (name, legal form, commercial register number, address, areas of activity), credit score with risk assessment and credit limit, shareholder structure and capital ratios, current and former directors, employee numbers, bank details, group and ownership structure, annual financial statements and balance sheet data (multiple years), negative features and key figures compared to the industry. The scope of information may vary by country.

features.title: What sets our software apart
features.subtitle: At CreditDevice you choose the package that suits you – modules for credit information, accounts receivable management, risk analysis and trade credit insurance in one application.

transparency.title: Full transparency about your debtors
transparency.description: Modules for credit information, accounts receivable management, risk analysis and trade credit insurance in one application. The current status of every debtor is clear to everyone in the company.

earlyPayment.title: Invoices paid earlier
earlyPayment.description: Speak your debtor's language: adapt the sequence, content, language and structure of the workflow per customer profile. The right tone – and you will be paid earlier.

reports.title: Tailored reports
reports.description: Inform management monthly about the largest debtors or account managers weekly about open items. Automatically via our flexible reporting tool.

actionLists.title: Save time with action lists
actionLists.description: Work daily based on action lists and avoid late payments. Customer profiles determine which action is planned for when.

groupLevel.title: Dunning at group level
groupLevel.description: Link multiple debtor numbers for the same customer. Very practical for parent and subsidiary companies – dun all at once, with comparison to the credit limit at each level.

complaints.title: Fast complaint processing
complaints.description: Record complaints easily and ensure they are processed quickly through clear communication and escalation.

uniqueness.title: How unique is CreditDevice?
uniqueness.body1: We believe that every credit manager benefits from just one application for all credit management services: the management of your trade credit insurance policy, your accounts receivable management, the retrieval of credit information and the analysis of risks.
uniqueness.body2: Our in-house developed Credit Management Software is linked to various credit information databases – direct online access to more than 430 million companies worldwide.
uniqueness.bullet1: One company licence – all users included

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Learn more about our Credit Management Software
faq.q1: Why use Credit Management Software in addition to accounting?
faq.a1: You already have accounting software – but often a traditional package is not flexible and versatile enough for modern credit management. Our software is built exactly for that.
faq.q2: How is the Credit Management Software linked to credit information?
faq.a2: The software is directly connected to credit information databases. You have online access to more than 430 million companies worldwide – a valuable combination for a complete picture of your debtors.
faq.q3: How does the software relate to the PolicyManager?
faq.a3: With the PolicyManager's notification system, you fulfil your credit insurer's obligations on time. You never lose insurance coverage and fulfil the obligations for compensation claims.
faq.a4: No. CreditDevice uses company licences that include all users.
faq.q5: What authorisation structures are available for users?
faq.a5: There is both a flexible role system and a possibility for data filtering, such as representing client structures and countries.

features.title: Discover your benefits
features.subtitle: Manual management of a trade credit insurance policy is a lot of work. The PolicyManager takes care of all that for you – and minimises the potential for errors.

subscription.title: Affordable subscription
subscription.description: The PolicyManager is available from 200 euros per month – within reach even for SMEs.

reminder.title: Automatic reminder
reminder.description: You automatically receive a signal, for example when a limit is exceeded.

timeSaving.title: You save time
timeSaving.description: Manual operations and searches are eliminated. Time you can use to prevent the loss of insurance cover.

currentData.title: Always current data
currentData.description: Updates on the status of your credit limits at least once a day. Decisions, cancellations and reductions are immediately visible.

costAnalysis.title: Analyse credit limit costs
costAnalysis.description: Analyse which credit limit is best suited for your customer – or replace a paid limit with a free self-assessment limit.

creditReports.title: Valuable credit reports
creditReports.description: Credit reports are the ideal instrument for setting a covered credit limit – fully integrated into all modules and affordable.

oneLimit.title: One company, one limit
oneLimit.description: The PolicyManager recognises companies with multiple debtor numbers and links all invoices to a single limit – via the commercial register number.

followUp.title: Organised follow-up
followUp.description: In the event of a claim, create an Excel document with overdue invoices and history with two mouse clicks – the insurer's obligations are fully met.

allInOne.title: Everything in one application
allInOne.body1: With CreditDevice's credit management modules, you combine everything in one application: the management of your trade credit insurance, your accounts receivable management, the retrieval of credit information and the analysis of risks.
allInOne.body2: With the PolicyManager, you manage your trade credit insurance policy perfectly – all modules are compatible with each other and you don't have to switch between systems.
allInOne.bullet1: Direct connection to your credit insurer's system
allInOne.bullet2: Updates on the status of your credit limits at least once a day
allInOne.bullet3: Compatible with Allianz Trade, Atradius, Coface
allInOne.bullet4: Obligations in the event of a claim are fully met

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Learn more about PolicyManager
faq.q1: Which credit insurers was the PolicyManager developed with?
faq.a1: The PolicyManager was developed in collaboration with Allianz Trade, Atradius and Coface to optimise and simplify the management of your trade credit insurance policy.
faq.a2: The PolicyManager is available from 200 euros per month. The product is therefore also affordable for SMEs.
faq.q3: How is data exchanged with the insurer?
faq.a3: A convenient web service with the insurer ensures that information is automatically exchanged. With each update, the system automatically generates new lists and notifications – this minimises errors and saves time.
faq.q4: How does the PolicyManager help with self-assessments?
faq.a4: The PolicyManager uses the same calculation method as the insurers – you immediately receive your credit limit along with the calculation.

hero.title: Credit Management — with passion
hero.subtitle: CreditDevice GmbH was founded in 2017 – as the result of over 30 years of collaboration and expertise in credit management. Our goal: a digital all-in-one package for credit management.

history.title: Our History
history.body1: CreditDevice GmbH emerged in 2017 from a long-standing partnership between Hans Geluk (CreditDevice B.V., Netherlands) and Sven Buckenberger. The idea: to bundle the accumulated know-how from decades in European credit management in a modern, digital product.
history.body2: In 2020, CreditDevice acquired the debt collection business of Hanse Debitoren Management, which had existed since 2011.
history.body3: In 2021, we acquired GlobalCompanyCheck e.U. and thus expanded our offering to include worldwide online company reports from over 200 countries – directly integrated into our Credit Management Software.
history.body4: Today we offer a complete solution: Credit Management Software, PolicyManager, international credit information and debt collection – all from one source.
history.claim: "A digital all-in-one package for credit management."
